corrections.reason: The glyph after ሥ is ራ (4th order ረ with bottom-right leg), forming ሥራ ('by their work I was glorified'), not ሥጋ.
The preposition ለ at the end of line 15 attaches directly to እለ at the start of line 16 (ለእለ).
The printed glyph at the end of ስበህ is clearly ህ (6th order ሀ), matching all parallel occurrences on the page (Col 1 L35, Col 2 L28, Col 3 L18-19), not ሕ.
The printed character has the labiovelar hook of ጕ (ወኢተኃጕለ), matching ኃጕል on the next line.
